_doc: Items. value = barter worth in scrap. weight in kg. use = effect when used from the inventory (needs deltas: thirst, hunger, warmth, fatigue are 0..100 where 100 is fully satisfied). sealed = Highmark ration seal. tags drive crafting and trade filters.

scrap.name: Scrap metal
scrap.desc: Cut sheet, bolts, brackets. The currency of the drift.

fibre.name: Plant fibre
fibre.desc: Stripped from drowned trees and raft gardens.

tape.name: Duct tape
tape.desc: Half a roll. Holds the world together.

copper.name: Copper wire
copper.desc: Stripped from walls. Traders love it.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Some charge left. Powers the flashlight.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.desc: From a cold stove. Filters water.

dirty_water.name: Dirty water
dirty_water.desc: Rain and rust. Drinking it is a gamble.

hm_water.name: Highmark water
hm_water.desc: A sealed bottle. 'SUPPLY AUTHORITY — RATION 1 OF 7'.

ration_bar.name: Ration bar
ration_bar.desc: Pressed grain, Highmark seal. 'Order and supply.'

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.desc: Highmark Health Authority. Counted, sealed, rare.

hull_patch.name: Hull patch
hull_patch.desc: Scrap plate and tape. Apply aboard the boat.

rope_hook.name: Rope and hook
rope_hook.desc: A grapple from bent rebar. Reaches high windows.

water_filter.name: Water filter
water_filter.desc: Bottle, cloth, charcoal. Turns dirty water clean.

lantern_parts.name: Lantern parts
lantern_parts.desc: A cracked housing and a wick.

oil.name: Lamp oil
oil.desc: Rendered fish oil. Smells of it.

lantern.name: Boat lantern
lantern.desc: Rig it on the boat's pole (F while piloting).

warm_coat.name: Oilskin coat
warm_coat.desc: Patched, waterproof-ish. Keeps the cold off.

permit_blank.name: Blank work permit
permit_blank.desc: Highmark watermark. Unsigned. Dangerous to carry.

photo.name: Photograph
photo.desc: A family on a balcony. Linden Court, before.
